metadata.description: HaCha AI Fact Checker benchmark dataset for Phase 13 evaluation.
metadata.label_notes: Verdict labels (SUPPORTED/FALSE/MISLEADING/UNVERIFIED) are SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDERS created to demonstrate the evaluation harness. They MUST be replaced with ground truth from primary sources (government docs, established fact-check orgs, peer-reviewed research) before being used to make accuracy claims about HaCha. See evaluation/README.md for labeling methodology.
